title: Field coefficient-stage compact-support projection laws
statement: Let S be the specified six-functor operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum] for finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, finite extension E of Q_l and positive finite level n. The canonical compact-support projection of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] satisfies CompactSupportProjectionLaws at S.higher.rational, S.closure.commonStage and every (S.closure.coefficientStages E0).rational. Each uses exactly the tensor and exchange data recorded at that stage and the entire second-input domain (the predicate True). Thus invertibility, naturality, compactification independence, composition, the associativity pentagon and proper-counit identification all hold at these field stages; the common-stage statement uses the specified common finite-field construction.

source.place: Finite formula, adic reconstruction, field transport and coherence paragraphs; coefficient-stage decomposition

proof.text: Uncurry the supplied mate into a natural transformation between the projection source and target bifunctors; its naturality is the required two-input equation. From SixFunctorExchangeComparison.projection, functorial preservation of isomorphisms and cancellation of the tensor/support/pullback comparison isomorphisms prove coefficient transport of invertibility.

Every integral model of a raw rational object is finite Tor by the residue criterion. Apply compactSupportProjectionFormula_integralStages and the coefficient transport calculation to prove rational invertibility at H = S.higher and every closure coefficient stage. Transport the four remaining equations by compactSupportProjectionCoherence_rational, and assemble their six law fields with the proved naturality.

For two common-stage pairs form the finite coefficient compositum. isoToStage represents both there. Their projection component is invertible by the rational-stage laws and SixFunctorExchangeComparison.projection; naturality along the two isoToStage isomorphisms then gives invertibility at the original pairs. compactSupportProjectionCoherence_common transports the four comparison equations from the finite fields. Combine these with the proved naturality and return the original three-clause conjunction.

proof_origin.place: S3: explicit mate naturality, inverse transport, raw rational object models, and finite compositum presentations. Only comparison-equation transport remains split off.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportProjectionFormula_fieldStages
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) :
    CompactSupportProjectionLaws S.higher.rational S.higher.rationalTensor
      S.higher.rationalExchange (fun _ _ ↦ True) ∧
    CompactSupportProjectionLaws S.closure.commonStage S.closure.commonStageTensor
      S.closure.commonStageExchange (fun _ _ ↦ True) ∧
    ∀ E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar,
      CompactSupportProjectionLaws (S.closure.coefficientStages E₀).rational
        (S.closure.coefficientStages E₀).rationalTensor
        (S.closure.coefficientStages E₀).rationalExchange (fun _ _ ↦ True)
